sentences.en: Her financial support is indispensable to this project of ours.
sentences.zh: 她的经济支持对我们这个项目来说是不可或缺的。

sentences.en: The things in this village are cheaper than those in ours.
sentences.zh: 这个村子里的东西比我们村子里的便宜。

sentences.en: The house whose roof you can see over there is ours.
sentences.zh: 那边可以看到屋顶的房子是我们的。
